findings.desc: experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs:419 and experiments/recovery-runner/parameterized-fault-profile.mjs:81-88: a dangling explicit --scenarioProfile flag fail-opens to the fixed default instead of exiting 2. Repro: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --record "$tmp/missing.jsonl" --tasks foo --k 1 --scenarioProfile; observed exit 0, 77 cells enumerated, and an exclusions sidecar written. Because arg() returns undefined for a missing flag value and parseScenarioProfile treats null/undefined profile+params as no flags, malformed profile input is accepted silently, violating the storys fail-closed profile validation contract and potentially running the wrong campaign if --engine is also supplied.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 90de58a81af05f444d6fa8c27330f226fd0ca8d5. run-driver now detects present flags with missing values before profile parsing, so dangling --scenarioProfile exits 2 before records/sidecars. Verified original repro exits 2 with no sidecars, dangling --scenarioParams exits 2 with no sidecars, --scenarioProfile weighted without params exits 2 with no sidecars, valid weighted profile still prints B1,B1,B2, git diff --check passes, and run-driver-selfcheck reports 167 assertions passed.

findings.desc: experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs:419-452 still parses non-profile CLI flags with arg(), which accepts a missing value or the next flag token as a value. Repro from a temp cwd: node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --record --tasks foo exits 0 and writes --tasks.exclusions.jsonl; node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --record /tmp/engine-next.jsonl --engine --k 1 exits 1 only after writing /tmp/engine-next.jsonl.exclusions.jsonl; node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --tasks exits via TypeError at line 441. This means the current runner is only fail-closed for the new --scenarioProfile/--scenarioParams path, while dangling --record/--engine/--tasks/--seed can still produce misleading sidecars or unstructured crashes before input is rejected, violating the fresh review focus on dangling flags and no sidecars on invalid input.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 419d6641b73c5eac4c67cd18badaada51223b51d. run-driver now rejects dangling shared CLI flags before enumeration or sidecar writes. Verified repros from temporary directories: --record --tasks foo exits 2 with no generated sidecars, --record <tmp>/engine-next.jsonl --engine --k 1 exits 2 with no generated sidecars, --tasks exits 2 with no generated sidecars, and --seed exits 2 with no generated sidecars. Also verified valid weighted profile still enumerates 15 cells/no-engine refusal, default --tasks foo --seed fixed --k 1 still enumerates 77 applicable cells/3 exclusions, weighted B1:2,B2:1 produces 15 unique canonical runIds, docs boundary phrases remain present, and run-driver-selfcheck reports 174 assertions passed, 0 failed.
